text:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] 429 spikes from tokenization pipeline in EU private deployments (vpc) — auto-page sent to #incidents and oncall. Probe started.

Olivia Chen: oncall here, ack. seeing elevated 429s hitting /v1/tokenize from several customer private endpoints in eu-west-1. rate ~8% of requests failing. paging win: @Samir @Luis please join.

Samir Patel: looking at router logs now. preliminary: tokenization microservice is returning 429s due to an internal token bucket being starved when batch size spikes ~> 256 tokens. queued requests backlog grew.

Meera Kulkarni: Meera (product) — collecting impact: do we have a list of affected private customers? Jordan, can you surface any escalate tickets? we need cautious language for status page / customer comms.

Jordan Lee: support here — I pulled recent alerts. Two enterprise customers in EU reporting increased failures in their integrations; one created a SEV ticket. I'll list customer IDs in the private thread but for status page we should say "subset of private EU customers".

Olivia Chen: Mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-request batch size limit to 128 via runtime flag 2) temporarily scale tokenization workers + add circuit breaker at ingress to convert some 429->queue with 202. Samir, can you test flag rollout? Luis, can you coordinate Dedicated/Private ops push?

Samir Patel: reproducing locally with load harness. change looks safe. patch: setenv TOKENIZE_MAX_BATCH=128. Test command:```bash
curl -X POST http://loadtest/tokenize -d '{"text": "long..."}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'``` Backpressure back to normal in sim.

Luis Fernandez: ops will push hotfix to private control plane. ETA ~12m for canary in eu-west-1. I'll update when published.

Meera Kulkarni: Drafting status page initial note (copy below). please request quick edits.

Meera Kulkarni: "We are investigating increased 429 responses from the tokenization service affecting a subset of Private EU deployments. Customers may see intermittent failures when sending long inputs. Our on-call team is actively mitigating; we will provide updates within 15 minutes. Impact: a portion of requests may receive 429; retries are recommended. Systems affected: tokenization pipeline (private EU)."

Samir Patel: i suggest replacing 'retries are recommended' with 'please retry with backoff' and add that streaming endpoints are not impacted if short inputs.

Jordan Lee: +1 on "please retry with backoff". Also add that customers using embeddings/short-chunking config are less likely to be impacted.

Kate Morrison: Docs check — link to our private-deploy runbook and recommended client-side backoff snippet would be useful. propose adding: https://redwood.docs/private/runbooks/tokenization-backoff

Olivia Chen: OK finalize: Meera please incorporate edits. Also add internal note: "On-call action: reduce TOKENIZE_MAX_BATCH to 128; monitor 429 rate <1% for 10m; escalate to eng-runtime if >5% persists."

Meera Kulkarni: Updated draft: "We are investigating increased 429 responses from the tokenization service impacting a subset of Private EU deployments. Customers may see intermittent failures with longer inputs. Our on-call team is actively mitigating (reducing max batch size and scaling tokenization workers). Please retry requests with exponential backoff; short inputs and embeddings workflows are less likely to be affected. We will post updates within 15 minutes. Impact: intermittent 429 responses for a subset of private EU deployments. For mitigation guidance see: https://redwood.docs/private/runbooks/tokenization-backoff"

Samir Patel: small nit: change 'reducing max batch size' -> 'temporarily reducing max batch size' to signal rollback later.

Meera Kulkarni: done. final draft saved.

Luis Fernandez: Canary push complete at 1958764305. Monitoring shows 429 rate dropped from 8% -> 0.9% across canary nodes. Scaling in progress for remaining nodes.

Incident Bot: auto-update: canary metrics show improvement, runbook link appended.

Jordan Lee: I'm prepping a customer DM template for affected customers: "We observed intermittent 429 responses from tokenization for private EU. Our team applied a mitigation; please retry with backoff. If you still see failures, reply with request IDs and we will investigate."

Olivia Chen: publish status page initial note now. Luis, you have ops perms?

Luis Fernandez: publishing initial update to status.redwood.com now. CLI:```bash
statusctl publish --component tokenization-private-eu --body "(Initial) We are investigating increased 429 responses..." --impact degraded```

Kate Morrison: Nice — once published I'll add the docs link in the status page details and attach internal playbook.

Samir Patel: Monitoring continuing; keeping an eye on 95th latency and 429 rate. If anything regresses I'll post immediate update.

Olivia Chen: 1958764330 — full rollout of the mitigation complete. 429 rate: 0.7% cluster-wide. We'll keep status page up with periodic updates.

Meera Kulkarni: Drafted follow-up update for status page (to be posted in ~20m): "Mitigation applied: temporarily reduced batch size and increased worker capacity. Observed error rate decreased to <1%. Continue to monitor; implement stable patch scheduled for next maintenance window."

Luis Fernandez: Follow-up published at 1958764360.

Incident Bot: remind: if error rate stays <1% for 60m, post resolved notice.

Olivia Chen: Confirming stabilised. I'm going to close the oncall pager in 45m if no recurrence.

Samir Patel: planned stable fix created PR: #4321. Will schedule for next deploy once QA signs off.

Jordan Lee: Sent proactive DM to affected customers at 1958764390 with the mitigation summary and contact instructions.

Meera Kulkarni: Publishing resolved copy now per runbook. Proposed resolved message: "Resolved — tokenization service (Private EU): We applied a temporary mitigation which reduced 429 responses. A stable code fix is scheduled. If you continue to experience issues contact support with request IDs. We're sorry for the disruption."

Olivia Chen: +1. Luis please publish resolved when we hit 60m stable.

Luis Fernandez: Resolved posted at 1958764399.

Samir Patel: closing notes: root cause: tokenization batching logic didn't account for pathological long-input bursts in private VPCs; fix will add adaptive batching and tighter backpressure.

Kate Morrison: I'll update the internal incident template and add this as an example in comms playbook. Good job team. :clap:

Olivia Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll add post-incident tasks to the retrospective board.

Incident Bot: Incident thread closed. Metrics: 429 peak 8% -> baseline <1%. Timeline and artifacts saved to /incidents/1958764321/ for runbook and postmortem.
